fingerprint_contract.environment: fingerprint.inputs.assurance-environment plus test-declared Factorio, mod, profile, scenario, and fixture inputs
fingerprint_contract.exact_match: the complete canonical fingerprint hash and definition hash identify reusable evidence

contradiction_policy.same_exact_identity: trusted contradictory attempts quarantine the identity

timing.rule: candidate execution reports observed durations; this source receipt stores no synthetic duration as a release measurement

checks: candidate-source, environment, command, and evaluator fingerprint invalidation

non_claims: This receipt does not treat a static proof as a release candidate qualification.
Evidence never crosses Factorio targets merely because a test identifier is similar.
A contradiction cannot be resolved by rerunning the same untrusted result.
